version_scope: Confirm SCIM version and BTP role model wording on Help Portal

claims.text: SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management) is commonly used as the provisioning protocol family for identity sync; confirm SAP IPS connector documentation for the exact profile in use.
A role template is an application-defined authorization template on SAP BTP that is exposed for assignment via role collections.
A role collection groups role templates (and related authorizations) for assignment to users or identity-provider groups on SAP BTP.

sources.section: IPS SCIM / BTP role collections and role templates (verify)
